mission.title: Apparition
mission.description: Find out what walked down the Ascension Monument and flattened seven Agents.

npc.say: I can't say that I have any idea at the moment.

phase.briefing: Something's been bollocksed in the Barrens, operative, and considering that seven Agents were flattened in the process, I suppose I can't blame it on you. Nevertheless, you're going to help deal with it. Malphas should have more details for you, if he's been sniffing about as he's supposed to.

enter.say:
Ah, the joys of working for someone who's bitter about living in the wrong century.
Malphas should be in there. No hostiles in sight.

talk.say: Reports from my sources in Westview are odd, and somewhat contradictory, but it appears that something quite unusual took place near Ascension Monument. A large man composed entirely of white neon wires, they say, walked down the monument, terrorized traffic, killed a group of Agents with a wave of his hand, and...

done.say: So let me guess: Flood's gonna want us to track this weirdo down.

phase.briefing:
Don't be ridiculous, {player}; the blood-drinkers are far better trackers than you. The lupines aren't so bad either, come to that.
However...some of them appear to have run into some sort of hitch. Why don't you just go see what they're up to?

enter.say: I've got some active programs in there, but they definitely aren't ours. Assuming that Flood sent us to the right address, this could mean trouble.

objective.text: Kill all of the Machine programs

done.say: Hm... I'm starting to get a picture here...

complete.say: Looks like the Machines really are out in force. They must be a little mad at the weirdo for smacking their Agents around. That could make getting to him a little tricky...

phase.briefing:
Oh, that's lovely news. Yes, thank you. Always the bearer of happy tidings, aren't you?
Fine, fine. Seeing as how I appear to be running short of search programs at an alarming rate, you've been promoted to a search party. Don't let it go to your head.

enter.say:
Unidentified signals again! Looks like redpills, this time--Machinists, maybe?
Hm... Weird reading there... Not sure what that was.

done.say: I think they've got one of our programs in there... Huh... I think it's dead, but... Damn it. I keep getting a sync error when I try to run a scan.

There's our program. What the hell is that on its head? I'm still getting sync errors... It's like its cycle speed is off. There's also some kind of code residue fouling up the readings... Can't make anything out of it.
Jeez, this is messed up. We'd better get back to Flood with this.

phase.briefing:
Frankly, operative, just about anything would have made more sense than what you just told me. Oh, this clay I have to work with...
I can see that it's time to call in a specialist. I'm setting up an appointment for you with Cerulean. She's an information and data expert, and besides, she spends most of her time in Westview. If anyone has actual hard data on this creature--or an idea of how to get it, anyway--she will.
She's a ghost, but try not to let that distract you.

enter.say:
Yeah, well, everyone's got their problems, huh?
Supernatural or not, she's supposed to be meeting you in there.

talk.say: Yes, of course I've seen them: code readings of a type completely...

done.say: Why? Because there's no telling what that code he wants tracked can do. It's already deleted some of your programs. Data is being lost, and I don't plan to risk mine--at least, not without compensation.

mission.finish:
Double?! Why, that grasping spectre...
You told her it was out of the question, of course. ... Didn't you?
{player}?
